content: {"title":"Database failover and split-brain after a primary dies","series":["system-design"],"topicClass":"internals","secondaryTopicClass":"concept","format":"card","lengthSec":50,"hook":{"kind":"puzzle","device":"failure_before_fix","shape":"A primary database dies overnight and writes stop, framed as a mismatch between a brief glitch and a long outage."},"arc":"failure hook → failover mechanism → open question → dated incident → split-brain twist → new rule → two-line close","videoDevices":["planted_question"],"beats":[{"role":"hook","summary":"An application writes to a primary database until it dies overnight and the writes stop, framed as a tiny hiccup with a long aftermath.","devices":["failure_before_fix"],"patterns":["failover"],"primitives":["node_card","connector"],"layoutMode":"pipeline"},{"role":"step","summary":"A follower is handed the leader badge, the other followers re-point to copy from it, and the application's writes re-route to the new primary.","patterns":["failover"],"primitives":["node_card","connector","tag"],"layoutMode":"pipeline","continuesPrevious":true},{"role":"twist","summary":"The board dims behind a short question card asking whether the old primary is really gone, and the question is left open.","devices":["planted_question"],"primitives":["statement_card"],"layoutMode":"centered_focus","continuesPrevious":true},{"role":"step","summary":"A sourced, dated case: two regional databases joined through a network hub lose their link, an outage clock runs, and the standby is promoted.","devices":["real_incident"],"patterns":["split_brain"],"primitives":["node_card","connector","counter"],"layoutMode":"versus_split"},{"role":"twist","summary":"The link returns with both sides holding the leader badge and their own new writes; the divergence is named and the merge turns out to be manual.","devices":["ownership_twist","what_breaks"],"patterns":["split_brain"],"primitives":["node_card","connector","callout","tag"],"layoutMode":"versus_split","continuesPrevious":true},{"role":"payoff","summary":"A rule label states the new policy the team adopted: no automatic promotion across regions.","primitives":["tag","callout"],"layoutMode":"centered_focus","continuesPrevious":true},{"role":"ending","summary":"A two-line contrast closes the lesson, one line on what is easy and one on what is hard, then a pointer to a longer video appears.","devices":["contrast_takeaway"],"primitives":["statement_card"],"layoutMode":"centered_focus","continuesPrevious":true}],"metaphorWorld":null,"pacing":["The failover demo moves fast; the incident and the divergence get the most screen time.","Two still moments: the open question and the closing contrast, both over a dimmed board.","The rule lands straight after the damage is shown, before any summary."],"unmapped":[{"kind":"other","name":"companion_video_pointer","description":"A small badge under the diagram window pointing viewers to a longer companion video.","closest":"callout","buildable":"yes"}],"namesToAvoid":[{"text":"database failover and split-brain (real incident)","kind":"title"},{"text":"seconds of glitch, a day of degradation","kind":"phrase"}]}

{"title":"How a live score reaches millions of phones","series":["system-design"],"topicClass":"product-design","format":"full","hook":{"kind":"puzzle","device":"persona_hook","shape":"A person sneaks a glance at a live score on a phone at work, and the question of where that number is born is left hanging."},"arc":"Persona hook with an open question → six steps through the write path, queue, workers and cache → the answer → callback ending","videoDevices":["planted_question"],"beats":[{"role":"hook","summary":"A person sneaks a look at a live score on a phone at work, and the question of where that number comes from is left open.","devices":["persona_hook","planted_question"],"patterns":[],"primitives":["device_frame","item_icon"],"layoutMode":"centered_focus","continuesPrevious":false},{"role":"step","summary":"The moment on the field becomes a record with an identity, a value, the people involved and a line of commentary.","devices":["object_to_data"],"patterns":[],"primitives":["data_block","item_icon"],"layoutMode":"centered_focus","continuesPrevious":false},{"role":"step","summary":"The record reaches a write endpoint; a second copy carrying the same identity is refused as a repeat, so the work happens once.","devices":[],"patterns":["reject_duplicate"],"primitives":["node_card","tag","command_bubble"],"layoutMode":"pipeline","continuesPrevious":true},{"role":"step","summary":"The accepted record is stored in a database and then handed to a queue as a waiting job.","devices":[],"patterns":[],"primitives":["node_card","connector","conveyor_queue"],"layoutMode":"pipeline","continuesPrevious":true},{"role":"step","summary":"Workers take jobs off the queue;
